summary: The legal endpoints have at most 16 decimal digits, which is too narrow for an honest runtime-scaling verdict; the accepted digit DP visits a constant number of decimal states per position.

replacement_checks.evidence: The accepted memoization has O(D) positions, constant tightness and previous-digit states, and ten transitions per state, establishing O(D) time over the complete legal width bound.
The dedicated regression compares the accepted adapter with direct decimal enumeration on sampled prefixes and ranges through one million, then checks full-width singleton and prefix identities.
